description: Fitting search fixtures of task T048. The document holds one shared definition file name, one dataset whose fitting split carries eight designed cases and whose validation split stays outside the search, the stored assessment of every fitting case, and six valid calibration plans. The facts object states the computed result of every plan through the Rust fitting boundary: the status, the case and candidate counts, the computed hash of the fitting split, the selected candidate with its objective counts, its goal rows, and its per-scope outcome counts, plus one row per enumerated candidate with its feasible flag, its objective counts, its unmet metric words, and its evidence states. The designed cases pin one known feasible candidate, one tie between two cutoffs that decide the same outcomes, two conflicting goals that no permitted candidate meets together, one unachievable goal that no candidate meets at all, one plan minimum that gates one goal, and one upper-bound basis that reads the Wilson bound. The invalid array holds rows that the fitting boundary must reject with the stated reason code and field path: validation data offered as fitting data, a split and a revision the dataset declares not, a plan that binds another definition, one assessment that names one holdout case, one fitting case without an assessment, and one assessment that names no declared answer.
